bugs.error_message: stitch MCP: 'Failed to connect - Incompatible auth server: does not support dynamic client registration'
bugs.root_cause: stitch was configured as an http server at https://stitch.googleapis.com/mcp. That endpoint requires a pre-registered OAuth client; Claude Code only performs dynamic client registration, so authentication can never succeed. Re-running the OAuth flow cannot fix it.
bugs.fix: Replaced with the stdio proxy: claude mcp add stitch -s user -e STITCH_API_KEY=<key> -- npx -y @_davideast/stitch-mcp proxy. The proxy hard-errors without STITCH_API_KEY or STITCH_ACCESS_TOKEN.

bugs.error_message: mcp__stitch__download_assets returned 'Assets downloaded to <dir>' but wrote no files anywhere on disk
bugs.root_cause: download_assets is a proxy-side convenience tool in @_davideast/stitch-mcp, not a real Stitch API call. It reports success unconditionally and silently writes nothing. Verified by searching the whole filesystem for files modified in the last 15 minutes.
bugs.fix: Ignore the tool. Take htmlCode.downloadUrl / screenshot.downloadUrl from list_screens and curl them. The html download URL is a base64 protobuf in which only the html_<32hex> file id varies, so every screen's URL is reconstructable from a constant prefix+suffix; the URLs need no auth.

bugs.error_message: e: Cannot access 'androidx.room3.RoomDatabase' which is a supertype of 'AnfasDatabase'. Check your module classpath for missing or conflicting dependencies.
bugs.root_cause: :core:database declared `implementation(libs.bundles.room)`, but AnfasDatabase extends RoomDatabase and DatabaseBuilderFactory returns RoomDatabase.Builder — room3-runtime is part of the module's ABI, so a consumer (:core:data) could not compile against it.
bugs.fix: Split the bundle: `api(libs.androidx.room3.runtime)` because it is in the ABI, `implementation(libs.androidx.sqlite.bundled)` because the driver is internal to buildDatabase(). Features still never see Room — anfas.kmp.feature withholds :core:database.

bugs.error_message: e: Name contains illegal characters: ",". (core/data + feature/members commonTest, only on compileTestKotlinIosSimulatorArm64)
bugs.root_cause: Backtick-quoted test function names containing a comma. The JVM target accepts them, so `:core:data:jvmTest` passed and the failure only appeared when `check` reached the Kotlin/Native test compilation.
bugs.fix: Stripped , ; : . from all backticked test names. Lesson: run `./gradlew check` (which compiles native test targets) before believing a KMP test suite is green — a jvmTest pass proves nothing about iOS.

bugs.error_message: e: Unresolved reference 'number' (kotlinx.datetime.Month.number)
bugs.root_cause: kotlinx-datetime 0.8.0's Month has no `number` property.
bugs.fix: Index a MonthAbbreviations array by Enum.ordinal; the enum is declared January..December in order.

bugs.error_message: e: Overload resolution ambiguity / Conflicting overloads in OfflineFirstMemberRepository.kt (runStorage, asStorageError)
bugs.root_cause: Extracted the shared error-boundary helpers into StorageBoundary.kt as `internal` while OfflineFirstMemberRepository.kt still had its own `private` copies with the same names in the same package.
bugs.fix: Deleted the private copies and rewrote the member repository to use the shared runStorage/asAppResult. Extracting a helper means removing the original, not adding a second.

bugs.error_message: e: Cannot access class 'kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate'. Check your module classpath (from :core:data)
bugs.root_cause: kotlinx-datetime was `implementation` in :core:model, but SubscriptionTerm.startsOn and RenewalQuote.endsOn expose LocalDate, so it is part of the module's ABI. Same class of mistake as bug-003 with room3.
bugs.fix: Changed to `api(libs.kotlinx.datetime)`. Rule: if a type from a dependency appears in your public signatures, it is `api`.

bugs.error_message: e: Unresolved reference 'datetime' in core/common/RelativeTime.kt — only during :core:common:compileCommonMainKotlinMetadata
bugs.root_cause: kotlinx-datetime was reached transitively via api(project(":core:model")). Platform compilations (jvmTest) resolved it, but commonMain *metadata* compilation did not, so `:core:common:jvmTest` passed while `check` failed later.
bugs.fix: Declared api(libs.kotlinx.datetime) directly in :core:common. Do not rely on a transitive api dependency in commonMain metadata compilation; declare ABI deps explicitly.

bugs.error_message: app.cash.turbine.TurbineAssertionError: Unconsumed events found (3 ReminderQueueComponentTest failures)
bugs.root_cause: A StateFlow keeps emitting after the assertion of interest — combine() re-emits when any upstream changes. Turbine treats leftover emissions at the end of a test() block as a failure.
bugs.fix: End each state.test { } block with cancelAndIgnoreRemainingEvents() once the interesting emission has been asserted.

bugs.error_message: e: Unresolved reference. None of the following candidates is applicable because of a receiver type mismatch (clock.now().todayIn(zone))
bugs.root_cause: kotlinx-datetime's todayIn is an extension on Clock, not on Instant.
bugs.fix: Call clock.todayIn(timeZone) directly.

bugs.error_message: AssertionError: expected:<[#88393, #88394]> but was:<[#88394]> — only one member imported instead of two
bugs.root_cause: The test fixture's newId lambda returned a constant string, so every imported row got the same member primary key and the Room upsert collapsed them into a single row. The repository was correct; the double-checked assertion caught the fixture.
bugs.fix: Made the fixture's newId a counter. Lesson: any injected id generator in a test must be unique per call, or upserts silently merge records and the test looks like a product bug.

bugs.error_message: e: Conflicting import: imported name 'IntakeReviewComponent' is ambiguous (RootComponent.kt)
bugs.root_cause: A python str.replace patch inserted the same import block twice because the anchor line appeared more than once in the file after an earlier partial edit.
bugs.fix: Deduplicated the imports by hand. When patching source with replace(), pass a count or assert the anchor occurs exactly once first.

bugs.error_message: Error resolving plugin [id: 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.serialization', version: '2.4.10'] > already on the classpath with an unknown version
bugs.root_cause: Applied the anfas.quality convention plugin at the ROOT project. That puts the convention project's entire runtime classpath -- including the Kotlin plugins -- on the root buildscript classpath, which every subproject inherits. Subprojects then cannot resolve their own plugin versions.
bugs.fix: Root applies Spotless by version-catalog alias instead, with its own small spotless block for root-level .kts. Modules get formatting via their anfas.* convention plugin. Never apply a convention plugin to the root project of this build.

bugs.error_message: Execution failed for task ':feature:announcements:spotlessKotlin' > Could not read path '.../merged_res/androidHostTest/.../values-ne_values-ne.arsc.flat'
bugs.root_cause: Spotless had targetExclude("**/build/**"), which forces it to ENUMERATE build intermediates in order to exclude them. AGP deletes merged-resource files mid-build, so the enumeration hit a file that had vanished.
bugs.fix: Dropped the targetExclude entirely. target("src/**/*.kt") already cannot match build/, which is a sibling of src/. Scope targets narrowly instead of excluding broadly.

bugs.error_message: Configuration cache problems: Task ':verifyIosVersionConfig' cannot serialize Gradle script object references
bugs.root_cause: A doLast block referenced a script-level function (renderIosVersionConfig). Task actions are serialized for the configuration cache and cannot capture script objects.
bugs.fix: Render the expected text at CONFIGURATION time into a local String and have the task action capture only that. Also: do not declare a generated file as an input of the task that verifies it -- Gradle reports an implicit task dependency. Use outputs.upToDateWhen { false } for a verification task instead.

bugs.error_message: androidx.sqlite.SQLiteException: Error code: 1555, UNIQUE constraint failed: room_master_table.id (MigrationV4ToV5Test)
bugs.root_cause: The test hand-inserted the schema identity hash into room_master_table, but a Room schema JSON's setupQueries ALREADY contain both the CREATE TABLE and the INSERT OR REPLACE for that row.
bugs.fix: Execute the schema's setupQueries verbatim and add no manual insert. Room will not recognise a hand-built database as being at version N without that row, so it must come from exactly one place.

bugs.error_message: macOS has no `timeout` command -- a verification run silently never started ('command not found: timeout')
bugs.root_cause: Used `timeout 90 ./gradlew ...` to bound a run. GNU coreutils is not present on macOS by default, so the whole pipeline failed and the absence of the expected log file was misread as a code problem.
bugs.fix: Background the process and poll for the expected condition with an until-loop, then pkill. Do not assume GNU coreutils on this machine.
